source: State Election Commission Kerala, Ward Directory / Elected Members (GE-2025)
covers: All local bodies: 6 municipal corporations (421 members), 87 municipal councils (3,206 members), 941 grama panchayats (17,337), 152 block panchayats (2,267), 14 district panchayats (346). Body types: C, M, G, B, D.

sample.name: Shanoph N A (Malayalam on list page)

how_to_scrape: GET /public/wyrdst/{C|M|G|B|D} (districts) -> /public/wyrlb/{district_no}/{type} (bodies, codes like M08037) -> /public/wyrw/{lb_id} (ward table: ward no, ward name, member, party, reservation; Malayalam) -> /public/wyr/view/{member_id} (English detail page with phone, address, age, votes, margin). About 4,000 detail pages for corporations + municipalities.

source: SEC Kerala TREND results portal (counting results per ward)
covers: Results of GE-2025, bye-elections 2021-2026 and GE-2020, all local bodies.

sample.note: Seen on /public/te/38 (Bye-Election page): 'B01010 Chirayinkeezhu ... LDF THIRUVANANTHAPURAM' rows with Ward Code, Ward Name, Status, Candidate, Votes, Nearest Rival, Votes, Margin

how_to_scrape: Secondary to the Ward Directory. /public/onser/trend redirects to /public/te/{election_id}; pick the election from the select list. Use only to cross-check winners and votes.

source: Tamil Nadu SEC, Urban Local Body Election Results 2022 (district-wise PDFs, Form 27 data)
covers: All 2022 urban bodies in 38 districts: 21 municipal corporations, 138 municipalities, 489 town panchayats (about 12,800 wards). Three PDFs per district: corp_, mun_, tp_. By-elections 2022 under rulbe2022/, Kadambur TP under ulbetp2022/.

sample.candidate: Karpagam R (Tamil; pdftotext drops some vowel signs)

how_to_scrape: Static PDFs: https://tnsec.tn.gov.in/tnsec_static/election_results/ulbe2022/{corp|mun|tp}_{district}.pdf, district codes from the select on ulbe2022.php (ari, cbe, chn, ... vpm, vlr). Text is Tamil in a legacy mPDF font: pdftotext loses some vowel signs, so names need OCR or careful glyph mapping; winners are the row with result 'வெற்றி'.

source: AP SEC, 2nd Ordinary Elections to ULBs 2026, Proforma X (votes of every candidate, incl. unanimous wards)
covers: Poll 01.11.2026, report 04.11.2026. Corporations PDF: 13 corporations, 1,056 'Elected' rows (134 pages). Municipalities PDF (Results - Ward Members, Muncipalities 2026.pdf): about 85 municipalities and nagar panchayats, 3,273 'Elected' rows (297 pages). Some bodies postponed (e.g. Mydukuru).
how_to_scrape: Download the two PDFs from https://sec.ap.gov.in/Uploads/Doc26/Rsls/ (paths are listed in the React bundle /static/js/main.*.js; also 'Ward Members-Declaration of Result - 03-11-2026.pdf', 'Mayors - Results 2026.pdf', 'Chairpersons - Results, 2026.pdf'). English text; pdftotext -layout gives one candidate per line, keep rows with 'Elected', carry district/body/ward down from the first row of each ward.

source: AP SEC, 2021 elected ward members lists (previous term)
covers: 2021 term: 12 corporations and 75 municipalities/NPs (also Elected_Ward_Members_Municipalities.pdf). Superseded by the 2026 results; useful for history only.
how_to_scrape: Not opened in this check (path seen in the site bundle). Use only for history.

source: Telangana SEC, Know Your Public Representative - Urban (Ward Member)
covers: Ordinary Elections to Municipalities and Municipal Corporations 2026 (poll 11.02.2026, election id 190): 116 municipalities + 7 municipal corporations (ward total not counted here; news reports 2,582 wards in the 116 municipalities). GHMC is not in it (no 2026 GHMC result); older years return no election in this form.
how_to_scrape: GET knowPRUrban.do (keeps JSESSIONID, read the Struts TOKEN hidden input); POST knowPRUrban.do?mode=getULB&district_id=01..33 for ULB ids; then POST knowPRUrban.se with TOKEN, mode=getULBWMDetails, property(knowYour)=WM, property(year)=2026, property(electionFor)=190, property(district_id), property(ulb_id), property(ward_id)=0, property(typeOfReport)=E (A = all contested candidates). One request per ULB, plain HTML table. No captcha.

covers: Party-wise ward totals per ULB for the 2026 election (123 ULBs). No names. Useful as a check of ward counts.
how_to_scrape: POST /AbstractResultReport.se with mode=getData and property(election)=190 (after a GET for the session cookie); one HTML table.

source: Karnataka ULB websites (KMDS Drupal template on *.mrc.gov.in), 'Know Your Members > Council Members'
covers: One site per ULB (corporations, CMCs, TMCs, town panchayats; about 300 bodies on the template). Content varies: Mysuru and Hubballi-Dharwad list corporators with ward and phone; Udupi CMC lists only the Administrator (council term over). Coverage must be checked per body.
election_year: 2018-2021 (varies by body; many councils have ended)

sample.name: Smt. Anita Chalageri
sample.address: Siddhartha Colony, Police Head Quarters Road Dharwad

how_to_scrape: For each ULB host (pattern {name}city.mrc.gov.in / {name}town.mrc.gov.in; use http://, https often times out) GET /en/council-members and parse the table; skip pages that show 'Name Of Administrator'. The host list must come from KMDS/DMA or from sites.csv.

covers: Archive of ULB elections 2013-2020 (and press notes for 2025 by-polls): links to result PDFs. The PDFs seen are party-wise abstracts per ULB in a legacy Kannada (Nudi) font, not ward-wise winner names. 'Elected representatives' pages for GBA, corporations, CMC, TMC, TP use the same grid and return the same archive (GBA: 0 rows).
how_to_scrape: POST JSON {"requiresCounts":true,"skip":0,"take":200,"cat":"CityMunicipal"} to /GV/GetResult (cat = MunicipalCorporation | CityMunicipal | TalukMunicipal | PattanaPanchayat | GBA). Not a source of councillor names; no ward-wise list found on the SEC site.

covers: No elected councils. The last municipal/commune elections were in 2006; the 2021 schedule did not lead to results on the site, and no 2026 local body poll is listed (site updated 23-Apr-2026; only ward maps, polling stations, electoral rolls 2022, delimitation 2021 for 5 municipalities: Puducherry, Oulgaret, Karaikal, Mahe, Yanam).
how_to_scrape: Nothing to scrape for councillors. Watch the home page 'What's New' / Notifications for a future poll; ward maps (e.g. /pondicherry-municipality-ward-maps) can feed the ward layer.
